I am extremely disappointed with this product. It is a cheap imitation of the authentic filter. Lesson learned for me! I bought this because it is  a cheaper replacement for my 18 months old LG filter. It installed just fine and fitted perfectly. However, the water quality is extremely poor even after 4 gallons of water flushing through this new filter. My tap water has 465 ppm of TDP. My 18 months old LG filter has 97 ppm. This "new" filter was able to get the water down only to 420 ppm. Acceptable drinking water is 300 ppm. The bottom line: do not waste your money or risking your health buying this product.

I purchased this for my grandfather as he was having water pressure issues. This was on an LG side by side (Freezer on bottom) fridge w/ ice/water in door. He recently got a new well and the sediment clogged the filter. Buying the OEM filter for $60+ every couple weeks was not going to work. I went to Amazon and found this to give it a try.

Despite the different label, the unit looks identical to the OEM unit. It removes and seats in the same. We ran one unit for 3 weeks (until it got clogged) and got another. This last one is going on over 4 months without issue. I will not be purchasing OEM filters anymore.

This is what I get for trying to be cheap on filters. The filter installed perfectly and fits great. Water flow initially was fairly normal on my LG fridge. I did not feel the water quality was any better than tap water out of my sink. Now after 2 months of use the filter has stopped up and has been rendered useless. The water barely trickles out now. It takes about 10 min to fill a glass of water. I have removed the filter, rinsed it out and it still trickles. I moved to a new house last week and out water pressure if even stronger at this house, yet our water filter still trickles. If you are looking for a good filter that is off brand and cheaper than the $50 the manufactures sell, I would in turn recommend Swift Green Filters.

I returned for credit and immediately purchased the genuine Kenmore water filter for my model.  Of course more expensive but worth it to not have some foreign specks in my ice. Now all clear ice.

Extremely poor substitute for OEM type filter. As other reviewers have noted, black sediment continued to be flushed through the water dispenser until about two gallons of water had flowed through. I accepted that as a "normal" result of installing a charcoal filtered device, What I didn't expect was the fact that the filter will not seal. We have had nothing but continuous drips of water from the weep hole in the filter housing just above our top shelf. We have tried removing the filter twice to give it a better seal with silicone based plumbers jelly as well as using Teflon tape - all to no avail. It appears that the "O" rings may not be sealing properly. Regardless, a filter should work properly under any of the above described circumstances. Will be contacting Amazon to attempt a return.

Put the new one in anyway and guess what- it leaked too. Just a continual drip, filling a cup under the filter housing every couple days. Factory using the wrong O rings in manufacture?
